This Hazardous Weather Outlook is for east central Indiana, 
southeast Indiana, northeast Kentucky, northern Kentucky, central 
Ohio, south central Ohio, southwest Ohio and west central Ohio.

.DAY ONE...Today and tonight.

There is a low probability for widespread hazardous weather.

.DAYS TWO THROUGH SEVEN...Wednesday through Monday.

There is an isolated potential for severe weather Wednesday 
afternoon into Wednesday evening with damaging winds and hail as
potential threats. 

The severe threat will transition over to a heavy rain threat 
overnight Wednesday night into early Thursday morning, leading to the
potential for some flooding.

There is an additional chance for isolated severe storms Thursday 
afternoon into Thursday night with damaging winds the primary threat.
 
Gusty winds upwards of 40 mph will be possible on Friday.

There will be the potential for frost this weekend.

.SPOTTER INFORMATION STATEMENT...

Spotter activation may be needed Wednesday and Thursday.
